card.name: Just before a cancer type is named
card.fires_on: Words and numbers right before a tumor type is named, such as the study number in an oncology trial table or 'cell' in 'squamous cell carcinoma'. It is strongest in head and neck cancer and other trial-result text.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of tumor and cancer words coming next and raises head, neck and lung terms.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to name a specific cancer, especially head and neck cancer.
